task.title: Project Kickoff Meeting
task.description: Conduct project kickoff meeting with all stakeholders to align on objectives, scope, timeline, and team responsibilities

task.title: Requirements Workshop
task.description: Facilitate requirements gathering workshops with business stakeholders to document functional and non-functional requirements

task.title: Stakeholder Mapping
task.description: Create stakeholder map identifying all stakeholders, their roles, influence levels, and communication preferences

task.title: Create Wireframes
task.description: Design low-fidelity wireframes for all major screens and user flows

task.title: Technical Architecture Design
task.description: Design system architecture including component diagrams, data models, and integration patterns

task.description: Conduct formal design review with stakeholders to approve designs before development

task.description: Configure development, testing, and staging environments with all required tools and dependencies

task.description: Implement assigned features according to specifications and coding standards

task.description: Review pull requests for code quality, standards compliance, and potential issues

task.description: Conduct UAT sessions with business users and document sign-off

task.description: Deliver training sessions to end users on system functionality and processes

task.title: Production Deployment
task.description: Deploy application to production environment following deployment checklist

role.name: Project Manager
role.description: Responsible for overall project delivery, timeline management, budget control, risk management, and stakeholder communication

role.name: Business Analyst
role.description: Gathers and documents business requirements, creates user stories, manages backlog, and facilitates stakeholder communication

role.name: Solution Architect
role.description: Designs technical architecture, makes technology decisions, ensures system scalability and maintainability

role.name: Development Lead
role.description: Technical lead responsible for development team, code reviews, technical decisions, and mentoring developers

role.name: Software Developer
role.description: Implements features according to specifications, writes tests, fixes bugs, and participates in code reviews

role.name: UX/UI Designer
role.description: Creates user experience designs, wireframes, mockups, and maintains design system consistency

role.name: QA Engineer
role.description: Plans and executes testing, manages test cases, reports bugs, and validates fixes

role.name: Training Specialist
role.description: Develops training materials, delivers training sessions, and ensures user adoption
